sources: CTICC, Events in Cape Town, What's On in Cape Town

events.title: Africa Women Innovation & Entrepreneurship Forum
events.blurb: Founders, funders and policy on building businesses in Africa. Check how to register.

events.title: BPESA GBS | BPO Conference and Alchemy Awards 2026
events.blurb: The business outsourcing sector meets, and it hires analysts. Likely industry-focused, so check access first.

events.title: The Cape Town Manufacturing Summit
events.blurb: A one-day summit on local industry. Listen for how firms talk about costs, jobs and trade.

events.title: Cape Town International Track Cycling Event
events.blurb: Fast racing on an indoor track. Practise panning shots and high shutter speeds.

events.title: Trash Bash: Clean Up Our Beaches for the Summer
events.blurb: A morning beach clean-up with the Two Oceans Aquarium. Meet people and help out.

events.title: Motherkind PowerHER Fit Fest
events.blurb: A fitness festival day. Check the post for the venue and times, then try a new class.

events.title: Africa Tech Festival
events.blurb: The continent's big tech gathering. Go to the data and AI talks and network for analyst roles.

events.title: Experience The Art of Light with Lumenocity at Norval Foundation
events.blurb: Walk through artworks made from light. Practise low-light exposure and colour control.

events.title: RMB Ultra-Trail Cape Town
events.blurb: A big trail-running weekend. Check the shorter distances, or go and cheer the runners on.

events.title: Red Bull King of the Air
events.blurb: Kitesurfers compete on big air. Practise telephoto tracking and shooting in harsh sun.

events.title: Streetopia!
events.blurb: A street festival in Obs. Practise candid portraits and telling a story in a photo set.

events.title: Taste of Cape Town
events.blurb: A weekend food festival. Go with friends and try something new.

events.title: Festive Lights Switch On
events.blurb: Night photography practice: long exposures and city lights.

events.title: EMEA Cash Cycle Seminar
events.blurb: Central banks and the cash industry on the future of money. Likely industry-only, so check access first.

events.title: St Luke's Tree of Lights
events.blurb: A community evening of lights in support of the hospice. Good low-light photo practice too.

events.title: We Are What Remains
events.blurb: An immersive exhibition of Indigenous art. Study how it uses pattern, material and colour.

events.title: Late Night Thrift in Observatory
events.when: See the listing for the next date
events.blurb: Hunt for garments to upcycle and fabrics for your swatch book.

events.title: Festive markets
events.blurb: Makers' markets across the city. See how local designers finish and price their work.
